description: Female vs male adjusted RR within age bands (sex known)
population: CRSS occupants of light passenger vehicles aged 8+ (known age), sex known
method: Model A (B for crash type) with product terms; four standardised margins per cell; IC = p11-p10-p01+p00, RERI = IC/p00, ratio of RR = RR11/(RR10*RR01); linearised CIs (t, 42 df). flag = stratum-specific RR (suppressed: a cell with n<30 or no events; unstable: a margin RSE>30%); interaction_flag also covers the reference level of factor b
